body:
## Context

1.11.0 arc follow-up (u5 item g, exotic config): with an ABSOLUTE external ticket store, no directory has a local store, so the enclosing-ADLC-repo tiebreaker cannot fire and a forged nested .git can capture root SELECTION (enforcement still applies; the selected root is wrong). Low severity — requires the external-store layout plus an in-checkout forgery — but it is the remaining hole in the boundary logic the arc hardened.

## What to change

When the store is external-absolute, derive the root candidate set from the session-start-armed roots / the configured mapping rather than the .git boundary walk alone; a mid-session-created .git must not outrank an armed root (extend the session_start-outranks-forgery rule to this configuration).

## Acceptance criteria

1. External-absolute store + forged nested .git: the resolved root is the armed root, not the forgery. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/*.test.mjs plugins/adlc-opencode/test/*.test.mjs` exits 0 with the regression present.
2. Normal local-store resolution unchanged (existing boundary suites stay green). verify: same command plus `node --test packages/context-handoff/test/*.test.mjs` exits 0.
title: context-handoff root resolution: an absolute external store must not let a forged nested .git become the resolved root
